text: {"distance_m": 3, "reasoning_short": "This is an estimate from small-target detection data, not resolution acuity. For tiny spots, the threshold depends on contrast times area (Ricco's law). Blackwell's data at indoor light levels put a 30%-contrast spot at about 1–1.2 arcmin, with some allowance for real-world viewing. A 1 mm spot subtends 1.2 arcmin at about 1 mm / (1.2 × 2.9e-4 rad) ≈ 2.9 m, so roughly 3 m."}
